en.title: Cooperative World3D terrain loading
en.body: Terrain stream loaders receive a per-request cancellation signal, notified on retirement or disposal. Cooperative jobs can settle promptly without exceeding the outstanding-load budget; stale results cannot publish. A terrain options factory receives each tile index and validated field. Two-argument loaders and static options remain compatible.

zh.title: World3D 流式地形协作取消
zh.body: 地形流加载器收到每次请求独立的取消信号，离开保留范围或销毁时通知。协作式任务可尽快结束而不放宽加载并发上限，旧结果不能发布。地形选项工厂收到各瓦片坐标和已验证的高度场。原双参数加载器和静态选项仍然兼容。
